zh.sourceText: 平台内部评估认为，这类餐品的复购主要依赖重口味刺激，持续推送会助长用户不健康的饮食习惯。小吃餐饮协会随即质疑，限流会让依赖高毛利小吃的夫妻店率先倒闭，这碗饭不该由平台来砸。平台数据显示，长期点这类餐品的用户体检异常率明显更高，推荐算法不该加剧这一风险。基于上述判断，某外卖平台宣布，将对平台上高油、高盐、高糖的商家实行流量限制，新规则从下季度起逐步推行。国家营养学会在公开科普中也多次呼吁，外卖平台应当承担引导健康饮食的社会责任。另一家外卖平台则趁机打出广告：『你的胃，由你自己做主。』

textRefs.conclusion_1: 将对平台上高油、高盐、高糖的商家实行流量限制
textRefs.reason_1: 这类餐品的复购主要依赖重口味刺激，持续推送会助长用户不健康的饮食习惯
textRefs.reason_2: 平台数据显示，长期点这类餐品的用户体检异常率明显更高
textRefs.reason_3: 国家营养学会在公开科普中也多次呼吁，外卖平台应当承担引导健康饮食的社会责任
textRefs.distractor_1: 限流会让依赖高毛利小吃的夫妻店率先倒闭

hints: 先找三条支持理由：它们散落在反对意见和政策主张的两侧
用户习惯、体检数据、营养学会分别提供了哪一种支持？
『夫妻店倒闭』听着像因果，但方向与结论相反；『由你自己做主』是竞品在打广告
zh.explanation: 三条理由分别是：重口味推送会助长不健康习惯、常点用户体检异常率更高、营养学会呼吁平台承担责任；它们共同支撑「对高油高盐高糖商家实行流量限制」。注意「夫妻店率先倒闭」同样是一条有因果结构的理由，但它支撑的是反对限流；「你的胃由你自己做主」则是竞品营销。理由分布在结论前后，判断关键是它支持哪一边。

en.sourceText: An internal platform review argued that repeat purchases of such meals rely mainly on heavy-flavor stimulation, and continuously recommending them encourages users' unhealthy eating habits. The snack-and-restaurant association objected that the traffic limit will let mom-and-pop shops that depend on high-margin snacks go out of business first. Platform data also shows that users who frequently order such meals have noticeably higher rates of abnormal health checkups, and its algorithm should not amplify that risk. Based on those judgments, a food-delivery platform announced it will limit traffic to merchants whose food is high in oil, salt, and sugar, rolling out the rules from next quarter. The platform also noted that the National Nutrition Society has repeatedly urged in public science outreach that delivery platforms should shoulder the social responsibility of guiding healthy eating. Another delivery platform then ran the ad: 'Your stomach, your own choice.'

textRefs.conclusion_1: limit traffic to merchants whose food is high in oil, salt, and sugar
textRefs.reason_1: repeat purchases of such meals rely mainly on heavy-flavor stimulation, and continuously recommending them encourages users' unhealthy eating habits
textRefs.reason_2: users who frequently order such meals have noticeably higher rates of abnormal health checkups
textRefs.reason_3: the National Nutrition Society has repeatedly urged in public science outreach that delivery platforms should shoulder the social responsibility of guiding healthy eating
textRefs.distractor_1: the traffic limit will let mom-and-pop shops that depend on high-margin snacks go out of business first

hints: Find the three supporting reasons first: they sit on both sides of an objection and the policy claim
What distinct support comes from user habits, health-checkup data, and the nutrition society?
'Mom-and-pop shops go out of business' sounds causal but runs against the conclusion; 'your stomach, your own choice' is a rival's ad
en.explanation: The three reasons are that heavy-flavor recommendations encourage unhealthy habits, frequent customers have more abnormal checkups, and the nutrition society urges platform responsibility; together they support limiting traffic to high-oil, high-salt, high-sugar merchants. 'Mom-and-pop shops go out of business' is also a causal reason, but it supports opposition to the limit; 'your stomach, your own choice' is rival marketing. Reasons now sit before and after the conclusion, so the key question is which side each sentence supports.
